subject: general
question: In which year was the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) introduced in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) scheme was launched on **October 2, 1975**.
 
• It is one of the world's largest and most unique outreach programs for early childhood care and development.
 
• ICDS aims to provide food, preschool education, and primary healthcare to children under 6 years of age and their mothers.
 
• The services provided include supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-ups, referral services, pre-school non-formal education, and health and nutrition education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supplementary Nutrition**

 
 
• Under ICDS, supplementary nutrition is provided to bridge the caloric gap between the national recommended and average intake of children and pregnant/nursing mothers.
 
• It is targeted at children under 6 years and pregnant/nursing mothers from low-income families.
 
 
 
• **Immunization**
 
 
• ICDS supports the Universal Immunization Programme (UIP) for protecting children against six vaccine-preventable diseases (tuberculosis, diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus, poliomyelitis, and measles).
 
• It also includes immunizing pregnant women against tetanus.
 
 
 
• **Health Check-ups**
 
 
• Regular health check-ups are conducted for children and mothers, including antenatal care for pregnant women and postnatal care for nursing mothers.
 
• The health check-ups help in early detection and treatment of diseases, and in promoting overall health and well-being.
 
 
 
• **Non-Formal Pre-School Education**
 
 
• ICDS provides pre-school education to children aged 3-6 years.
 
• This component aims to lay the foundation for proper psychological, physical, and social development of the child.
 
• It also helps in preparing the child for primary school education.
 
 
 
• **Health and Nutrition Education**
 
 
• Health and nutrition education is a key component of ICDS and aims to educate mothers on best practices related to health, nutrition, and child care.
 
• It promotes awareness and behavioral change among mothers, thereby improving health and nutritional status of children and mothers.
